description: EVERYTHING ABOUT ONE EVENT IN A SINGLE CALL, for a client that is drawing a whole page and would otherwise make five round trips: the event summary, the booth count with the first page of booths, the programme, the live offers and raffles, and `hasFloorplan`. Built for the web event door at sonarconnections.com/e/<eventId>, and useful to any caller that wants the whole picture at once rather than one section. `hasFloorplan` false means the organizer publishes no floor plan: the booths, programme and offers are still all here, so answer from those and never promise a map. Each block says whether there is `more` and which tool to page it with. IF YOU ONLY WANT ONE SECTION, call that section's own tool instead (events_get, events_booths, events_whats_on, events_offers): they are cheaper and they are unchanged. Accepts the event id, its public slug, or the event name.

eventIdOrSlug.description: Event id (belmont_stroll), public slug (cba26), or the event NAME as events_list spells it ("Summer Stroll & Savor"). Common short forms work too ("the stroll", "tie summit").
